issue.body:
Pytest is raising several warnings about packages we import that should use imports like `from collections.abc import Mapping` instead of from `from collections import Mapping`.

It'd be great if someone was up for raising pull requests against each of these packages fixing the imports in each case.


```
venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/promise/promise_list.py:2
  /Users/tomchristie/GitHub/encode/starlette/venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/promise/promise_list.py:2: DeprecationWarning: Using or importing the ABCs from 'collections' instead of from 'collections.abc' is deprecated, and in 3.8 it will stop working
    from collections import Iterable

venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/graphql/type/directives.py:55
  /Users/tomchristie/GitHub/encode/starlette/venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/graphql/type/directives.py:55: DeprecationWarning: Using or importing the ABCs from 'collections' instead of from 'collections.abc' is deprecated, and in 3.8 it will stop working
    args, collections.Mapping

venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/graphql/type/typemap.py:1
  /Users/tomchristie/GitHub/encode/starlette/venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/graphql/type/typemap.py:1: DeprecationWarning: Using or importing the ABCs from 'collections' instead of from 'collections.abc' is deprecated, and in 3.8 it will stop working
    from collections import OrderedDict, Sequence, defaultdict

tests/test_schemas.py::test_schema_generation
  /Users/tomchristie/GitHub/encode/starlette/venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/yaml/constructor.py:126: DeprecationWarning: Using or importing the ABCs from 'collections' instead of from 'collections.abc' is deprecated, and in 3.8 it will stop working
    if not isinstance(key, collections.Hashable):

tests/test_templates.py::test_templates
  /Users/tomchristie/GitHub/encode/starlette/venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/jinja2/utils.py:485: DeprecationWarning: Using or importing the ABCs from 'collections' instead of from 'collections.abc' is deprecated, and in 3.8 it will stop working
    from collections import MutableMapping

-- Docs: https://docs.pytest.org/en/latest/warnings.html
```
issue.title: Fix pytest warnings in related packages
